findings.statement: M-001 generated-US-17 keeps the transcript actor class (a marketer creating segments) and the transcript condition (vertical end-market: hospital vs EMS vs non-healthcare, including education/K-12). It changes the result: L177 states segmentation so the business can see how much is selling into each vertical from shipment/tracing data; generated-US-17's so-that is campaign targeting by where products are sold or used. 'Used' is not in the cited spans (sold/shipped/tracings).

evidence.statement: Packet structural_summary.generated.format_ok_count is 14 of 14 generated User Story rows. No row override: every Title is a short capability name that does not start with 'As a', and every Description matches generation.user_story.description_format / user_story.description_format pattern 'As a <role>, I need to <need>, so that <benefit>.'

Rulebook pattern confirmed on generated-US-4 through generated-US-20: Title 3 is an imperative capability (title_formats.user_story); Description is a single As-a / I-need-to / so-that sentence ending with a period.

Finding F-M-001 (evidence only; format score unchanged): match M-001 generated-US-17 does not break the rulebook sentence pattern, but it changes the transcript result. L177: vertical segmentation (hospitals versus EMS versus non-healthcare) to know sales into those markets from tracings of where devices shipped. generated-US-17 so-that: target campaigns by where products are sold or used. Actor remains a marketer; condition remains vertical end-market.

ASSUMPTION-USEVAL-002: a role is specific when the Description captures a non-empty role and that role, compared case-insensitively, is not exactly 'user' or 'users'. Packet structural_summary.generated.role_specific_count is 14 of 14. Captured roles: marketing data steward, marketing analyst, marketer, global product marketer, field marketer, product marketer, marketing operations lead. None equal user or users. No row override.
Packet generated_stories[*].structural.role_specific is true on every generated User Story row (generated-US-4 through generated-US-20).

Finding F-M-001 actor check (evidence only; role score unchanged): generated-US-17 role 'product marketer' is not generic under ASSUMPTION-USEVAL-002. L177/L397 do not name that job title; James speaks as Heartstream marketing requesting vertical segments. That is not a change of actor class (still a marketer creating segments), so role_specificity is not overridden.

open_items.statement: Role specificity method (generic roles are exactly user or users, case-insensitive) remains Draft — Pending Method Review.
